description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U2, the column twin of t5123-insert-row-past-last-row): references pushed past column XFD by insert_column A on S. S!XFA1 holds 3 and S!XFC1 7; S's last column is empty, so the insert pushes no content off the sheet. Sheet F holds A1 =S!XFD1, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =S!$XFD$1, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!XFA1:XFD1) (a range whose end is pushed off), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =SUM(S!XFD1:XFD3) (a range wholly in the last column), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7), A9 =S!XFC1 (the control: it moves to the last column and reads 7), A10 FORMULATEXT(A9), A11 =SUM(S!XFC:XFD) (a whole-column range whose end is pushed off), A12 FORMULATEXT(A11), A13 =SUM(S!XFD:XFD) (the whole last column), A14 FORMULATEXT(A13).
